newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Chief Minister of the Indian state of West Bengal Jyoti Basu will visit Bangladesh from November 27.
A mild earthquake rocked the southern port city of Chittagong and adjoining districts on Saturday. No damage was reported.

Former president Hussain Mohammad Ershad was granted bail in two more corruption cases. With those, Ershad has so far been given bail in nine out of 18 cases filed following his fall from power in 1990.

Jobaida Rashid, wife of fugitive army colonel Abdur Rashid, who is wanted for his role in the killing of independence leader Shiekh Mujibur Rahman, was sent to jail on Saturday. Mrs Rashid was arrested last week for possessing illegal firearms.
The government has decided to privatise 10 state-owned textile industries in phases.
